mapper.select: WITH route_info AS ( SELECT tr.id AS run_id, tr.train_id, fs.stop_seq AS from_seq, ts.stop_seq AS to_seq FROM train_run tr JOIN train_stop fs ON fs.train_id = tr.train_id AND fs.station_id = #{fromStationId} JOIN train_stop ts ON ts.train_id = tr.train_id AND ts.station_id = #{toStationId} AND ts.stop_seq > fs.stop_seq WHERE tr.id IN #{runId} ), available_seat AS ( SELECT route.run_id, coach.seat_type_id, inventory.seat_id FROM route_info route JOIN train_coach coach ON coach.train_id = route.train_id JOIN train_seat seat ON seat.coach_id = coach.id JOIN seat_segment_inventory inventory ON inventory.run_id = route.run_id AND inventory.seat_id = seat.id AND inventory.segment_seq >= route.from_seq AND inventory.segment_seq < route.to_seq GROUP BY route.run_id, coach.seat_type_id, inventory.seat_id, route.from_seq, route.to_seq HAVING COUNT(*) = route.to_seq - route.from_seq AND SUM(inventory.status = 'AVAILABLE') = route.to_seq - route.from_seq ), available_count AS ( SELECT run_id, seat_type_id, COUNT(*) AS available_count FROM available_seat GROUP BY run_id, seat_type_id ) SELECT route.run_id, seat_type.id AS seat_type_id, seat_type.code AS seat_type_code, seat_type.name AS seat_type_name, fare.price, COALESCE(available.available_count, 0) AS available_count FROM route_info route JOIN train_fare fare ON fare.train_id = route.train_id AND fare.from_seq = route.from_seq AND fare.to_seq = route.to_seq JOIN seat_type ON seat_type.id = fare.seat_type_id AND seat_type.enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN available_count available ON available.run_id = route.run_id AND available.seat_type_id = fare.seat_type_id ORDER BY route.run_id, seat_type.sort_no
SELECT id FROM seat_type WHERE code = #{seatTypeCode} AND enabled = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM seat_type WHERE id = #{seatTypeId} LIMIT 1
